coverage_credit_rule: Only reviewed file bodies count. Referenced production/JS files, discovered filenames and hash computation alone do not establish full review.

sections.contract: Config fallback and fixed model identity, time-control examples, port bounds, and OCR text sanitation; config file input is patched.
File presence and source-string assertions for capture, pinned model API usage, dependencies and batch startup wiring.

Launcher guard acquisition with a unique test name; actual launcher --check subprocess and in-memory tray image; mocked process ownership, taskkill runner, browser opening and occupied-port health states; frozen-bundle path resolution and import isolation.
PowerShell packaging, release readiness and quality tooling are checked by source text only.
Manifest/userscript/source contracts plus actual Node test subprocess calls for preview and extension storage logic.
Invokes separate Node fixture tests for notation parsing, side detection, insights, start position, session/style, orientation and board adapter.
Exact role colors, labels and upstream Stockfish archive hash are checked as source literals.

boundaries: The competing single-instance guard is asserted to fail only when os.name is nt. A passing Linux run does not validate the Windows named mutex.
Tray taskkill/process ownership and browser opening use doubles; no real Windows process tree or tray UI is exercised.
launcher --check is a real Python source subprocess, not a built Windows EXE or portable runtime start.
String assertions establish source wiring, not execution of .bat/PowerShell, getDisplayMedia, MV3 CSP, arrows, capture exclusion, the pinned model or the upstream executable.
Node subprocesses execute fixture test files. Their references do not grant this review complete coverage of those JS files or native browser acceptance.

sections.contract: Creates synthetic model_type config and literal fixture-weights bytes.
Calls real prepare_model with a mocked huggingface_hub module and checks offline flag, pinned repo/revision, allowed data patterns and absence of a trust_remote_code argument.
Rejects a missing weights file and a non-object config fixture.
Mocked setup failure produces a nonzero CLI result without the injected secret text; CLI defaults to download=False.

boundaries: Even download=True exercises only a mock argument contract and performs no network request.
fixture-weights is not a real safetensors model; these tests establish cache completeness handling, not weight format/integrity, actual loading, numerical output, memory use or inference readiness.
No Torch/GPU or real Hugging Face cache acceptance is performed by these fixtures.

sections.contract: Real in-memory ZIPs and temporary files; mocked download, forced os.name=nt, and archive/executable expected hashes patched to fixture data.
Wrong extracted hash preserves old bytes; valid fixture installs; already verified fixture avoids download; ambiguous executable candidates are rejected.
Checks bounded reads, corrupt archive rejection, interrupted-stream cleanup and extraction-size rejection while preserving previous bytes.
Actual installer subprocess returns nonzero on the unsupported host; this case is skipped on Windows.

boundaries: The executable is a short byte string, not a PE binary or a working Stockfish process.
Patching os.name does not provide native Windows filesystem, file-lock, antivirus, UAC or CPU compatibility coverage.
Patched expected hashes test verification logic but do not independently verify the real upstream release or its published hash.
The success test named atomically checks installed bytes and temporary cleanup; it does not measure concurrent readers, crash/power-loss behavior or native Windows replacement under locks.
No actual download, TLS/redirect behavior, installation into the user environment or UCI startup is exercised.

sections.contract: Extracts real live_server function bodies through AST, removes decorators and executes them with injected state, fake model/finder/analysis and real response/semaphore primitives.
Failed/not-started/loading state differentiation, 503 for unavailable Allie, Stockfish-only availability and Allie-only independence from Stockfish.
FEN analysis bypasses the Allie load gate; conflicting FEN and PGN returns 400 before that gate.
Retry-After survives HTTP error conversion; occupied analysis semaphore returns 429 and bounded retry header.

boundaries: No real ASGI transport, route registration, middleware, Host/Origin authentication or request-body/Pydantic validation is covered by decorator-free AST execution and SimpleNamespace requests.
Stockfish availability and model presence are supplied states; no actual engine/model readiness is demonstrated.
This file covers route decision logic and response data, not socket service startup or a packaged release smoke test.

sections.contract: Calls real readiness_status with model_loaded=True and proves loading/failed phases still return ready=False and model_not_loaded.

boundaries: Two pure decision cases only; no full readiness state matrix, real model load, real executable or HTTP integration is claimed.

sections.contract: Starts and terminates an actual owned sleeping Python child with stdout piped; checks that the child exited and includes cleanup.
Mocked communicate timeout triggers kill and returns the following diagnostic output.

boundaries: Only shutdown behavior is exercised; no release hash verification, bundled runtime start, HTTP /readyz probe, model inference or Stockfish startup is executed here.
The stubborn child is mocked. Native Windows process semantics and measured shutdown timing are not established by the fixture.

sections.contract: Fake frame/crop objects and deterministic OCR text keyed by horizontal crop coordinate.
Real sanitizer normalizes columnized move numbers and figurine SAN for two literal histories.
Real read_notation chooses the appropriate left/right crop using fake NumPy conversion and OCR; BoardVision construction is bypassed.

boundaries: No image pixels, real NumPy arrays, RapidOCR/chessvision model, capture source or visual recognition accuracy is tested.
The fixtures establish crop-side selection and text normalization, not OCR robustness across themes, scaling, compression or live window capture.

sections.contract: Real temporary extension build writes a 64-character revision, versioned stamp and expected ZIP members.

boundaries: Synthetic source only; no Edge installation, extension startup, signing or Windows packaging acceptance.

sections.contract: Synthetic source, filesystem snapshot and capability-dependent symlink fixtures.
Real path-collision, symlink/CLI and unrecognized/modified-output preservation checks.
Real repeated build and archive content, dangling-link copy failure and pre-1980 ZIP timestamp failure preserve old artifacts.

boundaries: 27 parameterized cases from 10 test functions; introduced after the baseline, so excluded from the original 153-file denominator.
Symlink cases can skip when privileges/capability are unavailable. Native Windows junctions and locked-file publication remain unexecuted.
Pre-publication preservation is covered; no common crash-atomic transaction across output directory and archive is claimed.

finding_limit: No new confirmed P1 emerged from this focused test-contract read. This is not a claim of complete production or platform correctness.
